title: WEB3 Pre ✔
tagline: We want to help the world Web3!  We believe every human should have a verified Web3 identity so they can travel easily/effectively around the internet and Web3
description:
Here in the US, TSA PRE  enables us to verify one time and then travel easily/efficiently around the US regardless of which city we visit, airport we travel through or airline we fly

Why don't we have this option online or in Web3?
We want people to travel easily/efficiently around the internet and Web3 with soulbound NFTs to identify them and their traits to enable frictionless transactions so we've created Web3 Pre ✔
how_its_made:
This project is deployed on Base, built with Unlock Protocol and uses XMTP for messaging to the user in Coinbase wallet.

It's built using the webhooks that are provided by UnlockProtocol to handle authentication and with the webhooks from zoom to move a person into the room.

Once the Zoom is completed a trait on the NFT is updated.
